companies.title: Company URLs, slugs or IDs
companies.description: Company overview URLs, /company/slug paths, exact slugs or numeric IDs. Direct lookup, not keyword search. Up to 5,000 combined inputs.

startUrls.title: Company URLs (optional)
startUrls.description: Alternative list of LinkedIn company overview URLs, added to Companies. Duplicate normalized inputs are removed.

maxConcurrency.title: Concurrent company requests
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum parallel lookups. Start low to reduce rate limiting.

maxRequestsPerMinute.title: Maximum requests per minute
maxRequestsPerMinute.description: Rate limit across company requests and retries.

maxRetries.title: Retries for temporary failures
maxRetries.description: Retries after network failures, rate limits or access restrictions. Missing pages (404) are not retried.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Time allowed for each HTTP request.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify or custom proxy. Direct requests are the default. Configure a proxy if LinkedIn restricts access. Proxy use may add charges.
